title: COSMIC TIDES (SAN JUAN DREAM)
style: Style: Psychedelic rock, slow groove, space guitar, ocean FX
lyrics:
[Intro — ocean waves, synth pad, slow guitar slide]

(waves… wind… distant echo…)

[Verse 1]

Sun falling into the sea
Golden light on you and me
Barefoot dreams on burning sand
Holding time in our hands

Radio hums in the air
Old songs floating everywhere
Every note feels alive
On this coastline of time

[Pre-Chorus]

Close my eyes, drift away
Every thought begins to sway

[Chorus]

We are riding cosmic tides
Hearts like stars in open skies
San Juan nights, burning slow
Let the universe flow

We don’t run, we don’t hide
We just ride these cosmic tides

[Verse 2]

Streetlight shadows on your face
Every moment out of place
But it feels so real tonight
Lost in sound, lost in light

[Bridge — spoken, echo]

“Somewhere… between the waves… and the stars…
We found ourselves…”

[Final Chorus]
[Outro — fading guitar + waves]
